description: VIN-specific manufacturer-reported open and completed recall status. Tesla and Ford open/completed states; GM completed/closed states with explicit repair dates where supplied; Honda and Acura active safety recalls; Subaru completed/incomplete safety recalls; Volkswagen, Audi, Land Rover and Jaguar recalls as reported by each maker; Nissan positive open safety recalls; Mopar positive open records matched to the full VIN. Service programs are separate. Toyota, Hyundai and Kia require interactive official verification. Unknowns are never zero. Not a complete service history. Where the maker's reply describes the VIN (Volkswagen, Audi, Land Rover, Jaguar, Subaru, Honda/Acura), manufacturer_description gives the raw text and only the fields it states.
name: vin_recall_status
